mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the air sacs and capillaries showed how oxygen and carbon dioxide cross in opposite directions while air and blood stay separate.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to join the airways to the sacs before adding elastic tissue was confusing: the new goal suggested that connection, but it was not available yet.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the airways could not connect until the elastic support had been added to the sacs.

arbitrary.text: The elastic tissue had a clear purpose once its expansion and recoil were shown, but needing it before connecting the airways was not clear from the new goal.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the lungs made gas exchange easier to picture, and I would be curious to see how they connect to the rest of the body.
